sms.otp: Your sign-in code is {code}. It expires in 5 minutes. Do not share it.

requested.sms: New booking request {code} for "{title}". Accept or decline within 24 hours.

confirmed.sms: Booking {code} is confirmed: "{title}". Thank you! Your receipt is in your account.

confirmed_owner.sms: Booking {code} for "{title}" is paid and confirmed.

declined.sms: Sorry, request {code} for "{title}" was declined. Try another listing.

expired.sms: Booking {code} for "{title}" was cancelled because the time to pay ran out.

failed.sms: Payment for booking {code} failed. Try again or use another network.

refunded.sms: Your payment of {amount} for booking {code} was refunded because the dates are no longer available.

installment_reminder.sms: Reminder: rent for month {seq} ({code}) of {amount} is due {due}.

installment_overdue.sms: Rent for month {seq} of "{title}" ({code}) is 7 days overdue.

installment_paid.sms: We received rent for month {seq} ({amount}) for booking {code}. Thank you!

verified.sms: Your owner account is verified. Your approved listings are now visible to renters.

rejected.sms: Your owner verification was not approved: {reason}. Fix it in your account and submit again.

approved.sms: Your listing "{title}" is approved and live.

rejected.sms: Your listing "{title}" was not approved: {reason}. Edit it and submit again.

changes_approved.sms: Your changes to "{title}" are approved and live.

changes_rejected.sms: Your changes to "{title}" were not approved: {reason}. The listing stays live as before.

suspended.sms: Your listing "{title}" was suspended: {reason}. Contact support for help.
